# API & Data Integrity Requirements Checklist: Kanban Ticketing System

**Purpose**: Validate the quality (completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, coverage) of the API, error-handling and move/reorder requirements before implementation
**Created**: 2026-10-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the fields and format of the "consistent, clear error" defined in the spec itself, rather than only in the plan/contracts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for listing tickets (e.g. filtering by assignee, type or priority) or is their absence intentionally excluded? [Gap]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements specified for how a user clears an assignee or changes description to empty when editing a ticket? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK004 Is it specified whether editing a ticket may change its column or position, or only via move/reorder? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for the content and shape of the "ticket details" and "board view" responses (which fields, nesting)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK006 Is the expected API behavior defined for pagination or result limits on boards, comments and history? [Gap]
- [x] CHK007 Are comment length limits and author-name length limits specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK008 Are length limits for board names and assignee names specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK009 Are requirements defined for the seed data the app starts with, given the spec mentions none? [Gap, Traceability]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK010 Is "clear error that identifies what was wrong" defined with measurable content (e.g. offending field, reason)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-021, §SC-007]
- [x] CHK011 Is the "limit" in "beyond a stated limit" tied to the specific values in Assumptions, and are those assumed values promoted into a numbered requirement? [Ambiguity, Spec Edge Cases, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK012 Is "chronological order" defined for entries sharing the same timestamp (tie-breaking)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-016, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK013 Is "case-insensitively" unique board naming defined for non-ASCII/Unicode characters? [Clarity, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK014 Is the character-counting basis (code points, bytes, trimmed or untrimmed) for the 200/10,000 limits specified? [Clarity, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK015 Is the key format specified for numbers beyond a given width (e.g. TKT-1000), and is the case sensitivity of key lookup defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK016 Is "unassigned" representation defined (absent vs. empty string) and does whitespace trimming apply to assignee? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK017 Is "a single action" in SC-005 defined in API terms (one request) given the feature has no UI? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK018 Is "under 1 minute" (SC-001) meaningful for an API-only deliverable, and is its measurement method defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK019 Do the move rules (FR-012: upper bound = count allowed) and reorder rules (FR-013: upper bound = count − 1) align with the edge case "move to same column at a different position is a reorder"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §FR-013, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Is it consistent that the same-column move is treated as reorder (range n−1) while Story 2 scenario 3 describes insertion into a column generally? [Conflict, Spec US2 §3]
- [x] CHK021 Do the trimming/empty rules in Clarifications apply consistently to description and assignee, not only to titles, names, comments and authors? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK022 Is the "status change" terminology consistent with "column change" across FR-017, FR-018 and User Story 3? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK023 Is the creation history entry (previous column "none") consistent with SC-006 ("no missing or extra entries") and US3 scenario 3 which expects two entries after two moves? [Conflict, Spec §SC-006, US3 §3, §5]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK024 Can SC-003 (200 tickets in under 2 seconds) be objectively measured, with the environment and measurement point stated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK025 Can SC-002 ("no duplicates across at least 1,000 tickets") be verified under concurrent creation, and is the concurrency level stated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK026 Is SC-004 ("100% of cases") tied to a defined set of operation sequences? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK027 Does every functional requirement have a corresponding acceptance scenario (e.g. FR-011 edit, FR-003 list boards, FR-020 persistence)? [Coverage, Traceability]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK028 Are requirements defined for moving or reordering within a column that has exactly one ticket, or an empty target column? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §FR-012, §FR-013]
- [x] CHK029 Are requirements defined for moving a ticket to its current column and its current position (a no-op)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK030 Are requirements defined for ordering of tickets that remain in the source column after a cross-column move (gap-free closure)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK031 Are requirements specified for malformed input (wrong JSON types, non-integer positions, negative positions, null vs. missing fields)? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK032 Are requirements defined for concurrent moves/reorders affecting the same column? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK033 Is the all-or-nothing behavior for failed moves defined for partial failure, including history-entry writes? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-015, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK034 Are rollback/failure requirements defined when creating a ticket partially fails (key consumed but ticket not stored)? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK035 Are requirements defined for adding comments or moving tickets referencing a non-existent ticket key and for malformed keys? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK036 Are durability requirements for "survive restarts" quantified or scoped (e.g. after crash vs. clean shutdown)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK037 Are requirements stated for not leaking internal details (stack traces) in error responses, at spec level? [Gap, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK038 Are timestamp requirements (timezone, precision, format) defined for history, comments and ticket times? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK039 Are cross-origin access requirements (allowed frontend origin) documented as a requirement rather than only in the plan? [Gap, Traceability]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK040 Is the assumption that priority levels are low/medium/high/critical validated, and is it flagged as pending confirmation? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [x] CHK041 Is the single global key sequence across boards validated against the case of future board deletion or multi-team use? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [x] CHK042 Is the unspecified behavior for deletion explicitly captured as a requirement-level exclusion rather than only an edge-case note? [Ambiguity, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK043 Is a requirement/acceptance-criteria ID scheme for edge cases and assumptions established so they can be traced to tests? [Traceability, Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
